inspected_sources.author: Enrico Camporeale, Gian Luca Delzanno, Benjamin K. Bergen and J. David Moulton
inspected_sources.title: On the velocity space discretization for the Vlasov–Poisson system: comparison between Hermite spectral and Particle-in-Cell methods. Part 1: semi-implicit scheme
inspected_sources.review_scope: Read selected original arXiv v2 sections2 (normalized1D1V Vlasov–Poisson),4 and5.2/5.4 (recurrence/noise and linear-window distinction). No whole-paper review, copied reference table, or original-run reproduction. Our positive-weight quiet loading and two-stream inputs differ.

review.ja: 原著の規格化方程式、再帰・雑音、Landauと二流の線形窓の議論を選択して確認。原著の計算値は転用しません。
review.en: Selected original equations and diagnostic limitations inspected; independently derived continuum references are evaluated here.

inspected_sources.title: Plasma dispersion function: official API mathematics
